mapper.select: SELECT pp.id AS policyId, pp.perm_id AS permId, pp.status AS policyStatus, pp.access_type AS accessType, pp.field_operates AS fieldOperates, pp.table_name AS tableName, p.perm_code AS permCode FROM sys_user_perm_rel upr LEFT JOIN sys_perm_policy pp ON upr.policy_id = pp.id AND pp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' LEFT JOIN sys_perm p ON pp.perm_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE upr.user_id = #{userTenantRelId} AND upr.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED'
